card.title: DEWOITINE D.520
card.flavorText: The Dewoitine D.520 was a French fighter aircraft that came into service in 1940 and was used by the French Air Force during WWII. The D.520 was a modern aircraft for its time, it had good firepower and a powerful engine, and was close to being a match to the German Messerschmitt BF 109. However, the D.520 did not have a real impact since production had just started in 1940 and only 79 were in service when the Battle of France began. Following the fall of France in 1940 the D.520 continued to be used, both by the Free French and the Vichy Air Force. The aircraft was retired in 1953 and by then 900 units had been built.
